subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay bounded media from unmentioned group messages for later mentioned turns, and what media-kind, TTL, local-path, and context-visibility limits must apply?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but fixing it changes how attachments from unmentioned group participants can later enter model context, so automation should not choose the privacy and retention boundary.

options.title: Approve bounded local-image retention
options.body: Record only capped local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and replay it through the existing recent-history image pipeline under current group authorization and visibility rules.

options.title: Keep text-only history
options.body: Preserve today’s safer behavior and document that unmentioned Telegram media is not replayed unless it is part of the current or visible reply turn.

options.title: Defer for shared channel policy
options.body: Keep this issue open until Telegram and the related WhatsApp path use one reviewed retention model for unmentioned group media.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded local-image retention
recommendation.body: Record only capped local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and replay it through the existing recent-history image pipeline under current group authorization and visibility rules.
